JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A private reflection and journal entry written by the authenticated user.

id.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

body.description: Markdown-formatted body text of the entry

mood.description: Emotional state tag selected by user (calm, focused, anxious, grateful, etc.)

tags.description: Categorical tags associated with this journal entry

GeminiInteraction.title: GeminiInteraction
GeminiInteraction.description: A conversational multi-turn AI reflection dialogue between the user and Gemini.

id.description: Unique identifier of the interaction turn

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

entryId.description: ID of the associated journal entry if linked to a specific entry

text.description: Text content of the reflection or response

modelUsed.description: Model identifier used for generation (e.g., gemini-3.8-flash)

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Stores user journal entries with strict owner-bound isolation.

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: Stores multi-turn conversational reflections with strict owner-bound isolation.
